description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git rebase' with various options, edge cases, and scenarios. It includes setup, test cases, and helper functions for the rebase testing framework.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Helper function to compare a git graph output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compare the current HEAD revision with a given revision.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Create a test commit with optional parameters.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advance the test 'clock' to simulate passage of time.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Set a specific git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Check that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Check that a file path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Check that a path is a file.

methods.name: test_reworded_commits
methods.description: Verify specific commits have been reworded.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Write a set of lines to a file for comparison.

methods.name: set_reword_editor
methods.description: Configure environment for rewording commits during rebase.
